new_primary_findings.claim: The handbook itself labels this photographed chassis MAZ-543A. The visible lower step is below the door-bearing fixed sill in the region forward of the near first wheel.
new_primary_findings.boundary: Halftone oblique photo; no calibrated coordinates, exact clearance, hidden mount identity, individual vehicle production year or serial number established

new_primary_findings.locator: scan unit 89/p.174 figure 101 and scan unit 90/p.177 upper cab view of figure 102
new_primary_findings.claim: Both general cab drawings show a connected lower frame, two distinct tread regions and three support positions below the fixed sill. The step does not trace the complete cab lower perimeter or its rear extension.
new_primary_findings.boundary: General cab illustrations; not manufacturing/detail drawings. Do not infer a metric end position, section size, flexibility or joint design from linework

new_primary_findings.locator: scan unit 90/p.176, figure 102 tilt-mechanism inset and caption
new_primary_findings.claim: Cable callout 17 is attached to the cab-tilting mechanism, not to a lower-step support.
new_primary_findings.boundary: Does not specify whether the step supports themselves contain cable

new_primary_findings.locator: scan unit 3/p.3 introduction; scan unit 87/p.170 cab description
new_primary_findings.claim: The introduction treats 543 as the base and describes differences for 543A/543V/543M, with documentation current to 1977-01-01. The cab prose expressly groups 543 and 543A as two two-seat, two-door cabs.
new_primary_findings.boundary: This establishes handbook scope, not identity of every lower-step revision or target vehicle batch
